title: Bacterial Mask Contamination in Operating Room
official: Bacterial Contamination Associated With Surgical Mask Configuration in Unscrubbed Operating Room Personnel: A Randomized Microbiological Study
summary: The primary objective of this study is to determine whether surgical mask configuration policy-compliant (up or off ) versus mask dangling is associated with differences in bacterial contamination among unscrubbed operating room personnel at Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist Hospital.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria

* Age 18 years or older
* Employment in perioperative services
* Routine use of surgical masks during clinical duties
* Ability and willingness to comply with the assigned mask configuration

Exclusion Criteria

* Active respiratory infection or febrile illness at the time of participation.
* Active facial or neck skin infection that could influence bacterial culture results.
* Inability to safely wear a surgical mask.
* Inability or unwillingness to comply with the assigned mask configuration or other study procedures.
